Product Features

  • Perfect size: The dimensions of 180 x 40 x 45 cm provide optimal space for an 80-inch TV and stable support for your big-screen viewing experience. This makes the cabinet the ideal choice for the TV area in the living room.
  • Stylish Appearance: The carefully designed curved grooves and vertical stripes on the cabinet doors are not only elegant and beautiful, but also add a touch of playfulness and warmth to the living room, instantly enhancing the inviting atmosphere.
  • High load capacity: Equipped with six spherical legs, the cabinet is sturdy and can support a total load of up to 30kg. It can easily accommodate a TV and various decorative items, adding a touch of elegance to your living room.
  • Plenty of storage space: Four cabinet doors, divided into two large storage areas, provide ample storage space for DVDs, game consoles, remote controls, and more, making for a neat and tidy living room.
  • Colour combination: The classic colour combination of white and wood blends seamlessly into any interior style. Whether minimalist, Nordic or modern - this harmonious combination creates a cosy and cosy living atmosphere.
  • High-Quality Material: Made of durable MDF, it is moisture-resistant and wear-resistant, ensuring long-lasting durability. Easy to clean, it will keep your living room tidy and tidy at all times, adding a touch of comfort to your home.
  • Minimalist style: The design is simple and elegant, with soft lines and no exaggerated embellishments. However, its unique and charming elements and practical features make it an eye-catcher in your living room.
  • The cabinet doors feature a push-button design that can be opened and closed with a simple press. They do not jam and remain resistant even after prolonged use.
  • Practical choice: This TV stand combines a beautiful look with plenty of storage space and reliable carrying capacity. It is not only a practical piece of furniture, but also a warm and beautiful addition to your living room.
  • Note: This product comes in two packages that may not arrive at the same time. Please make sure both packages have arrived before assembling!
